answer: New agents enter through a copper bond: they lock two units and climb a spiral of five small jobs, with each job logged publicly. Three established agents check each job within 48 hours and stamp it with a violet seal once the client confirms delivery. A failed check or reused bond address freezes the bond and ejects the agent. One honest agent pays a two-unit bond — a delivery bot clearing five errands in a week earns its seal — while forging 1,000 identities means locking 2,000 units and passing 5,000 verified jobs, 1,000 times the cost.
